heading_en: Market Risk Equivalent Amount of the Foreign Exchange Risk Category
summary_ja: 外国為替リスク・カテゴリーのマーケット・リスク相当額を、金及び外国為替の全体のネット・ポジションの額に八パーセントを乗じて算出する。
summary_en: Calculates the foreign exchange risk category amount as 8% of the overall net position in gold and foreign exchange.
paragraphs: The market risk equivalent amount of the foreign exchange risk category set forth in Article 271, paragraph (1), item (iii) shall be the amount obtained by multiplying by 8% the amount of the overall net position, calculated by the method prescribed in the following Article, for positions in gold and foreign exchange.
